title: Conditioning and exact convergence
promptMarkdown: For L=½(x²+25y²), derive the range of positive constant GD steps guaranteeing convergence from every start. Starting at(1,1), compute the first two steps for η=.04 andη=.09. Find the minimax constant step for parameter contraction and its contraction factor. Explain why observing convergence from y₀=0 would not establish stability for all starts.
hintLadder: Diagonal quadratics separate into scalar recurrences.
Require absolute multiplier less than one in both directions.
Balance the two endpoint multipliers for the minimax choice.
